Under the general direction of the APS Director, the APS Project Analyst serves as a seasoned program and data professional supporting APS program operations through the administration of APS learning management systems and program data platforms, management of the APS educational and county stipend programs, the development of enduring policies and procedures, and support for training and implementation activities.
35% - Program Data Management and Analysis

The APS Project Analyst serves as the lead administrator for APS learning management systems and data management platforms (e.g., AirTable), ensuring data integrity, regulatory compliance, and high-quality reporting. This role is responsible for analyzing program data; developing dashboards and reports; and applying data driven insights to support operational decision making, monitor implementation progress, and drive continuous quality improvement. The incumbent exercises independent judgment, analytical expertise, and professional discretion to identify implementation risks, recommend system and process improvements, and strengthen the overall effectiveness and sustainability of APS programs.
35% - Program Implementation

In collaboration with internal teams, county APS partners, CDSS, fiscal units, and external stakeholders, the APS Project Analyst facilitates stakeholder engagement, communication, and outreach activities that promote program participation and alignment with APS workforce development goals.
30% - Stipend Program Administration
Strong written and verbal communication skills to prepare reports, presentations, training materials, and recommendations for a variety of audiences.

Knowledge of the Adult Protective Services (APS) Stipend Program or related Human Services programs, including program administration, eligibility requirements, participant tracking, reporting requirements, and stakeholder engagement. Knowledge of Destiny, Canvas, and other educational program databases.
Demonstrated analytical skills to identify programmatic issues, evaluate data, develop recommendations, and implement effective solutions to support program goals and objectives.
Knowledge of workflow automation tools and methodologies to enhance data collection processes, improve reporting accuracy, and increase operational efficiency.
